Ability.Name: -- Arena Functions --
Ability.Lua:
-- Arena helpers, loaded once via FuncLoadedArena guard. Runs every tick but body is idempotent. if not FuncLoadedArena then FuncLoadedArena = true
-- Rolling HP samples per unit for burst detection (no combat-log parsing). ArenaHPHist = ArenaHPHist or {} ArenaDmgWindow = 5
function ArenaSampleHP(unit) if not UnitExists(unit) or UnitIsDeadOrGhost(unit) then return end local guid = UnitGUID(unit) if not guid then return end local hp = 100 * UnitHealth(unit) / UnitHealthMax(unit) local t = GetTime() local hist = ArenaHPHist[guid] if not hist then hist = {}; ArenaHPHist[guid] = hist end hist[#hist + 1] = { t = t, hp = hp } while hist[1] and (t - hist[1].t) > ArenaDmgWindow do table.remove(hist, 1) end end
-- Percent HP lost across the current sample window. function ArenaGetDrop(unit) if not UnitExists(unit) then return 0 end local guid = UnitGUID(unit) if not guid then return 0 end local hist = ArenaHPHist[guid] if not hist or #hist < 2 then return 0 end local first = hist[1].hp local last = hist[#hist].hp local d = first - last if d < 0 then return 0 end return d end
-- CC id tables. Kept small on purpose; covers the common 3.3.5a arena/BG suite. ArenaStuns = { 408, 1833, 20549, 24394, 44572, 46968, 47481, 5211, 22703, 25046, 39796, 8983, 22570, 6789, 9005 } ArenaFears = { 5782, 6358, 8122, 8143, 5484, 17928 } ArenaSilences = { 15487, 18498, 25046, 47476, 34490, 55021, 31935, 18425 } ArenaRootIds = { 339, 26989, 53308, 122, 33395, 12494, 4167, 54706, 19675 } ArenaSnareIds = { 45524, 1715, 12323, 3409, 26679, 29793, 61391, 3600, 8034 } ArenaPolyIds = { 118, 12824, 12825, 12826, 28271, 28272, 61305, 61721, 61780, 51514 }
function ArenaHasDebuffList(unit, list) for i = 1, #list do if UnitDebuffID(unit, list[i]) then return true end end return false end function ArenaStunned(u) return ArenaHasDebuffList(u, ArenaStuns) end function ArenaFeared(u) return ArenaHasDebuffList(u, ArenaFears) end function ArenaSilenced(u) return ArenaHasDebuffList(u, ArenaSilences) end function ArenaRooted(u) return ArenaHasDebuffList(u, ArenaRootIds) end function ArenaSnared(u) return ArenaHasDebuffList(u, ArenaSnareIds) end function ArenaPolyd(u) return ArenaHasDebuffList(u, ArenaPolyIds) end function ArenaCCed(u) return ArenaStunned(u) or ArenaFeared(u) or ArenaSilenced(u) or ArenaPolyd(u) end
-- Can I hardcast right now? (stun/fear/silence/poly block cast-time heals) function ArenaCanHardcast() if ArenaStunned("player") or ArenaFeared("player") or ArenaSilenced("player") or ArenaPolyd("player") then return false end return true end
-- HoT presence (mine) and remaining seconds. function ArenaMyHoT(unit, spellId) local n, _, _, _, _, _, expire = UnitBuffID(unit, spellId, "player") if not n then return false, 0 end return true, (expire or 0) - GetTime() end
function ArenaHasAnyHoT(unit) return (ArenaMyHoT(unit, 48441)) or (ArenaMyHoT(unit, 48443)) or (ArenaMyHoT(unit, 48451)) or (ArenaMyHoT(unit, 53251)) end
-- Range + LoS proxy: IsSpellInRange returns 1 only when both range AND LoS OK. function ArenaReachable(unit) if not UnitExists(unit) then return false end if UnitIsDeadOrGhost(unit) then return false end local ht = GetSpellInfo(48378) if not ht then return false end return IsSpellInRange(ht, unit) == 1 end
function ArenaValidAlly(unit) if not UnitExists(unit) then return false end if UnitIsDeadOrGhost(unit) then return false end if not UnitIsFriend("player", unit) then return false end if UnitIsCharmed(unit) then return false end if UnitHasVehicleUI(unit) then return false end if UnitDebuffID(unit, 69065) then return false end if UnitDebuffID(unit, 70157) then return false end return true end
-- Lower score = more urgent to heal. Projects damage forward and rewards HoT coverage. function ArenaScore(unit) local hp = 100 * UnitHealth(unit) / UnitHealthMax(unit) local drop = ArenaGetDrop(unit) local projected = drop * (3 / ArenaDmgWindow) local score = hp - projected local hots = 0 if UnitBuffID(unit, 48441, "player") then hots = hots + 1 end if UnitBuffID(unit, 48443, "player") then hots = hots + 1 end if UnitBuffID(unit, 48451, "player") then hots = hots + 1 end if UnitBuffID(unit, 53251, "player") then hots = hots + 1 end score = score + (hots * 2) if not ArenaReachable(unit) then score = score + 100 end if ArenaPolyd(unit) and hp > 40 then score = score + 50 end return score end
-- Skip healing if the target is currently heal-immune / cannot be affected. ArenaHealImmunities = { 45438, 642, 33786, 6940, 46924 } function ArenaBuffedOut(unit) for i = 1, #ArenaHealImmunities do if UnitBuffID(unit, ArenaHealImmunities[i]) then return true end end return false end
-- Rate-limited chat print for decisions (2s per key). ArenaLastMsg = ArenaLastMsg or {} function ArenaSay(key, msg) local t = GetTime() if (ArenaLastMsg[key] or 0) + 2 > t then return end ArenaLastMsg[key] = t if PQR_WriteToChat then PQR_WriteToChat("|cff88ff88[Arena]|r " .. tostring(msg)) end end end

Ability.Name: -- Arena Heal Engine --

-- Builds ally list, samples HP for burst tracker, picks PQR_CustomTarget with self-danger override. local list = { "player" } local group = GetNumRaidMembers() > 0 and "raid" or "party" local n = group == "raid" and GetNumRaidMembers() or GetNumPartyMembers() for i = 1, n do list[#list + 1] = group .. i end
for i = 1, #list do ArenaSampleHP(list[i]) end
local playerHP = 100 * UnitHealth("player") / UnitHealthMax("player") local playerDrop = ArenaGetDrop("player") or 0
ArenaSelfDanger = false if playerHP < 40 then ArenaSelfDanger = true end if playerHP < 65 and playerDrop > 25 then ArenaSelfDanger = true end if playerHP < 80 and playerDrop > 40 then ArenaSelfDanger = true end

ArenaLowMembers = 0 ArenaCritMembers = 0 for i = 1, #list do local u = list[i] if ArenaValidAlly(u) then local hp = 100 * UnitHealth(u) / UnitHealthMax(u) if hp < 85 then ArenaLowMembers = ArenaLowMembers + 1 end if hp < 45 then ArenaCritMembers = ArenaCritMembers + 1 end end end

Requires HoT on target for the talent bonus and can-cast state. local t = PQR_CustomTarget if not t then return false end if not ArenaValidAlly(t) then return false end if not ArenaCanHardcast() then return false end if not pStay() then return false end if not ArenaReachable(t) then return false end if UnitCastingInfo("player") or UnitChannelInfo("player") then return false end local hp = 100 * UnitHealth(t) / UnitHealthMax(t) if hp > 55 then return false end if not (UnitBuffID(t, 48441, "player") or UnitBuffID(t, 48443, "player") or UnitBuffID(t, 48451, "player") or UnitBuffID(t, 53251, "player")) then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Abolish Poison (Priority)
Ability.Lua: -- Poison dispel on the pressured unit only. Saves GCDs vs whole-party scan. local t = ArenaPressured if not t then return false end if not ArenaValidAlly(t) then return false end if not ArenaReachable(t) then return false end if UnitBuffID(t, 2893) then return false end local j = 1 while true do local name, _, _, _, dtype, dur = UnitDebuff(t, j) if not name then return false end if dtype == "Poison" and (dur or 0) > 1 then CastSpellByID(2893, t) ArenaSay("abol", "Abolish Poison on " .. (UnitName(t) or "?")) return true end j = j + 1 end

Ability.Name: Arena:Remove Curse (Priority)
Ability.Lua: -- Curse dispel on the pressured unit only. local t = ArenaPressured if not t then return false end if not ArenaValidAlly(t) then return false end if not ArenaReachable(t) then return false end local j = 1 while true do local name, _, _, _, dtype, dur = UnitDebuff(t, j) if not name then return false end if dtype == "Curse" and (dur or 0) > 1 then CastSpellByID(2782, t) ArenaSay("curse", "Remove Curse on " .. (UnitName(t) or "?")) return true end j = j + 1 end

Ability.Name: Arena:Shapeshift Break
Ability.Lua: -- Bear powershift to break roots (always) or snares (only when HP-safe, since it costs a GCD + leaves ToL). if not UnitAffectingCombat("player") then return false end if UnitChannelInfo("player") then return false end local rooted = ArenaRooted("player") local snared = ArenaSnared("player") if not rooted and not snared then return false end if snared and not rooted and getHp("player") < 60 then return false end if not UnitBuffID("player", 9634) then CastSpellByID(9634) end ArenaSay("bear", "Bear powershift break") return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Rejuvenation (Refresh)
Ability.Lua: -- Pandemic Rejuv: refresh when missing or < 3s remain. Skip overhealing at 92%+. local t = PQR_CustomTarget if not t then return false end if not ArenaValidAlly(t) then return false end if not ArenaReachable(t) then return false end local hp = 100 * UnitHealth(t) / UnitHealthMax(t) if hp > 92 then return false end local up, rem = ArenaMyHoT(t, 48441) if up and rem > 3 then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Lifebloom (Stack)
Ability.Lua: -- Stack Lifebloom on pressured target only. Nil-safe count/expire check. local t = PQR_CustomTarget if not t then return false end if not ArenaValidAlly(t) then return false end if not ArenaReachable(t) then return false end local hp = 100 * UnitHealth(t) / UnitHealthMax(t) local drop = ArenaGetDrop(t) or 0 if hp > 85 and drop < 10 then return false end local _, _, _, count, _, _, expire = UnitBuffID(t, 48451, "player") if count == 3 and expire and (expire - GetTime()) > 3 then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Regrowth (HoT Missing)
Ability.Lua: -- Only (re)apply Regrowth when its HoT is missing. Nourish handles subsequent fast heals. local t = PQR_CustomTarget if not t then return false end if not ArenaValidAlly(t) then return false end if not ArenaCanHardcast() then return false end if not pStay() then return false end if not ArenaReachable(t) then return false end if UnitCastingInfo("player") or UnitChannelInfo("player") then return false end local hp = 100 * UnitHealth(t) / UnitHealthMax(t) if hp > 80 then return false end if UnitBuffID(t, 48443, "player") then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Wild Growth (Maintenance)
Ability.Lua: -- Maintenance WG: only when 2+ members are low. Chosen target must not already carry my WG. if not IsSpellKnown(53251) then return false end if CooldownRemains(53251) then return false end local t = PQR_CustomTarget if not t then return false end if not ArenaReachable(t) then return false end if (ArenaLowMembers or 0) < 2 then return false end if UnitBuffID(t, 53251, "player") then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Innervate (Smart)
Ability.Lua: -- Smart Innervate: mana below 50% AND player is currently able to channel/cast. if CooldownRemains(29166) then return false end if UnitBuffID("player", 29166) then return false end if not UnitAffectingCombat("player") then return false end if getMana("player") > 50 then return false end if ArenaStunned("player") or ArenaFeared("player") or ArenaSilenced("player") or ArenaPolyd("player") then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:War Stomp (Tauren)
Ability.Lua: -- Tauren racial melee peel. HP-gated so we don't burn a GCD off-cooldown when safe. if not IsSpellKnown(20549) then return false end if CooldownRemains(20549) then return false end if not UnitAffectingCombat("player") then return false end if not UnitExists("target") then return false end if UnitCanAttack("player","target") ~= 1 then return false end if not UnitIsPlayer("target") and not PQR_TestMode then return false end if not rangeCheck(20549, "target") then return false end if PQR_TestMode then return true end local _, cls = UnitClass("target") local isMelee = cls == "WARRIOR" or cls == "ROGUE" or cls == "DEATHKNIGHT" or cls == "PALADIN" or cls == "SHAMAN" or cls == "HUNTER" if not isMelee then return false end if getHp("player") > 70 then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Cyclone (Focus)
Ability.Lua: -- Cyclone focus. Heal-first priority is enforced by ROTATION ORDER (default heals run before this). -- Only self-danger blocks; ordering handles the rest so we still fire against enemy healers/melee even during BG fights. if not UnitExists("focus") then return false end if UnitIsDeadOrGhost("focus") then return false end if not UnitIsPlayer("focus") and not PQR_TestMode then return false end if not UnitCanAttack("player", "focus") then return false end if not rangeCheck(33786, "focus") then return false end if UnitDebuffID("focus", 33786) then return false end if PQR_IsCastingSpell(33786) then return false end if not ArenaCanHardcast() then return false end if PQR_TestMode then return true end if ArenaSelfDanger then return false end local n, _, _, _, _, _, _, _, notInt = UnitCastingInfo("focus") if n and not notInt then return true end local cn, _, _, _, _, _, _, cNotInt = UnitChannelInfo("focus") if cn and not cNotInt then return true end local _, cls = UnitClass("focus") local isHealer = cls == "PRIEST" or cls == "DRUID" or cls == "PALADIN" or cls == "SHAMAN" if isHealer and getHp("focus") < 95 then return true end return false

Ability.Name: Arena:Entangling Roots (Focus)
Ability.Lua: -- Entangling Roots focus: melee focus not already CCed. Heal-first via rotation order (default heals run first). if not UnitExists("focus") then return false end if UnitIsDeadOrGhost("focus") then return false end if not UnitIsPlayer("focus") and not PQR_TestMode then return false end if not UnitCanAttack("player", "focus") then return false end if not rangeCheck(53308, "focus") then return false end if UnitDebuffID("focus", 339) or UnitDebuffID("focus", 26989) or UnitDebuffID("focus", 53308) then return false end if UnitDebuffID("focus", 33786) then return false end if PQR_IsCastingSpell(53308) then return false end if not ArenaCanHardcast() then return false end if PQR_TestMode then return true end if ArenaSelfDanger then return false end local _, cls = UnitClass("focus") local isMelee = cls == "WARRIOR" or cls == "ROGUE" or cls == "DEATHKNIGHT" or cls == "PALADIN" or cls == "SHAMAN" or cls == "DRUID" or cls == "HUNTER" if not isMelee then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Faerie Fire (Anti-Stealth)
Ability.Lua: -- Anti-stealth FF for Rogue/Druid target. Heal-first via rotation order. if CooldownRemains(770) then return false end if not UnitExists("target") then return false end if not UnitIsPlayer("target") and not PQR_TestMode then return false end if not UnitCanAttack("player", "target") then return false end if not rangeCheck(770, "target") then return false end if UnitDebuffID("target", 770) or UnitDebuffID("target", 91565) or UnitDebuffID("target", 26993) then return false end if not ArenaCanHardcast() then return false end if PQR_TestMode then return true end if ArenaSelfDanger then return false end local _, cls = UnitClass("target") if cls ~= "ROGUE" and cls ~= "DRUID" then return false end return true

Ability.Name: Arena:Healing Touch (Regular)
Ability.Lua: -- Default cast-time heal when no HoT is up (Nourish would be weaker without HoT). local t = PQR_CustomTarget if not t then return false end if not ArenaValidAlly(t) then return false end if not ArenaCanHardcast() then return false end if not pStay() then return false end if not ArenaReachable(t) then return false end if UnitCastingInfo("player") or UnitChannelInfo("player") then return false end local hp = 100 * UnitHealth(t) / UnitHealthMax(t) if hp > 70 then return false end if UnitBuffID(t, 48441, "player") or UnitBuffID(t, 48443, "player") or UnitBuffID(t, 48451, "player") then return false end return true
